ideas.title: The Impact of Fraud on Minnesota's Nonprofit Sector
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota's nonprofit sector and its impact on the community
questions: What is the extent of fraud in Minnesota's nonprofit sector?
How does it impact the community?
ideas.insight: The nonprofit sector in Minnesota may be vulnerable to fraud, as evidenced by the Aimee Bock case. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the issue.

ideas.title: Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the issue of daycare fraud in Minnesota, including the $5.4M scheme and other cases
questions: What is the extent of daycare fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: Daycare-related fraud has been a significant issue in Minnesota, with multiple cases reported. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the issue and how to prevent it.
